poorLayoutAttribution.structuralSolver: Primary source-backed cause: the solver seeds a degree-ranked center/ring arrangement and performs only bounded node repulsion plus neighbor attraction. It does not score or reject edge crossings, route occupancy, Relation-label placement, Node-label placement, Self-loop pressure, or viewport quality.
poorLayoutAttribution.productPresentation: Downstream presentation recomputes after the Node positions change, but current applyAutoLayout has no candidate-set evaluation or Product-authoritative selection loop. Therefore routing/label feedback can expose the structural solver's misses rather than repair them globally.
poorLayoutAttribution.lifecycle: No partial async result is involved in the current explicit operation, so stale delivery is not the current source of the messy layout. There is no running operation state, mid-run Cancel, snapshot identity, or rollback state in App.
poorLayoutAttribution.authorityMismatch: The current operation is structurally deterministic but not a complete Product-quality placement operation; the mismatch is solver quality plus absent proposal/selection lifecycle, not a Dataset or routing authority violation.
